sources.title: AI and Islamophobia: The algorithmic gaze on Muslim communities
sources.snippet: Online platforms claim to mitigate hate speech, yet research suggests a different pattern when it comes to anti-Muslim content. For example, the independent organisation Center for Countering Digital Hate (CCDH) reported in 2023 that social-media companies failed to act on 89% of anti-Muslim (Islamophobia) hate that was reported.
